name: inst.flags
meaning: Instance flag word. Bit 0 (INST_F_DRAWN) is set or cleared by the world draws each frame; bit 1 is set by Instance_InitBase for resType 0x26.

name: inst.mode
meaning: Same instance header as ScnObject inst.mode (both initialised by Instance_InitBase 0x55b224); was "resType". WAR resource type the object was created from: 3, 0xB, 0x26 (rigid) or 4 (animated). Game_Frame draws resType 0x26 before the Z clear via WorldObj_DrawSky.

name: inst.kind
meaning: Same instance header as ScnObject inst.kind (both initialised by Instance_InitBase 0x55b224); was "drawKind". Index into g_worldObjDrawFns 0x57eaf0: 0 hidden, 1 type 3, 2 type 0xB, 3 type 0x26 (sky), 4 animated. VisibilityManager writes 0 to hide and restores the saved value.

name: inst.model
meaning: Same instance header as ScnObject inst.model (both initialised by Instance_InitBase 0x55b224). WAR resource record address (blob + offset). It is the key for Texture_FindByResource, which returns the built Mesh.

name: aabb
meaning: min = World-space minimum of the mesh vertices ((s16)__ftol), from WorldObj_CalcMeshAabb. Passed to Cull_IsAabbVisible as the start of {min[3], pad, max[3]}. For a type-4 object this slot is the instance position instead.; max = World-space maximum of the mesh vertices. The rigid allocation is 0x18 bytes; +0xE and +0x16 are never written for rigid kinds. For type 4 this is the instance rotation, and the object continues with the Animator at +0x30 and pose buffers at +0x54.
